entries.title: On a Windows PC, a task starts with a pnpm project's packages installed
entries.body: On a Windows PC, Infinitary now installs a pnpm project's packages into a task's working copy before its crewmate starts, as it does on a Mac. Before, that install never started there, and a working copy reused from an earlier task kept packages that pointed at that task's deleted folder, so builds and tests could fail until the crewmate installed them again.
entries.noPicture: This changes what a task's working copy holds before its crewmate starts, not how any view looks.
